'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Thomas Schumann LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Schumann]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' QMC
* '''Username:''' RepCom1136
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
